leadText: Hazel's Holiday (Japanese: マロンのメリークリスマス Merry Christmas), is the sixth chapter of the fifth volume of Magical Pokémon Journey.
plainText:
Hazel's Holiday (Japanese: マロンのメリークリスマス Merry Christmas), is the sixth chapter of the fifth volume of Magical Pokémon Journey.

==Plot==
 
Almond is ditching Hazel's Christmas party to go see a rare with the Pokémon Fan Club. Hazel decides she's better off without him and throws her party anyway, but the Pokémon can tell her heart isn't in it.

==Important characters and Pokémon==
Hazel
Almond
Peanut
